title: Memory Marker / Icon and color
slide_intent: Separate the cues people remember so a designer can evaluate each cue and their combination.
strategic_value: Freddie and yellow can reinforce recognition together while remaining individually identifiable.
demonstration: Two circles compare Freddie on pale gray with a solid yellow disc, accompanied by orange handwritten notes.
practical_value: Compare the contribution of a mascot with that of a repeated color.

content_islands.name: Icon specimen
content_islands.spec: Place Freddie inside the left gray circle with the handwritten icon note below.

content_islands.name: Color specimen
content_islands.spec: Place a yellow circle at right with its handwritten color note.

reference_purposes.Expression: The board isolates an icon and a yellow swatch.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Memory Marker description identifies memorable cues as aids to recognition.

ingredient.name: Freddie and yellow
ingredient.role: Provide a character cue and a color cue.
ingredient.application: Compare the two cues separately before judging their combined effect.
ingredient.scope: Observed case-study comparison; no color proportion is prescribed.
